answer: A concrete sybil-defense mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The required words slot into it cleanly: nebula tracks the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, ocean maps onto the random sampling that seats juries, and fable embodies the compute burned to admit each new identity. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
